department: Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science

gre_subject.value: No subject test is listed for computer science.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are required, but waived for applicants holding an EECS master's.
gre_general.quote: Submit the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores

also.quote: The GRE requirement is waived for students with a Master’s degree from EECS

supervisor.value: Applicants name two or three EECS faculty whose research fits; the page does not require a faculty agreement.
supervisor.quote: Name two or three faculty members whose research aligns with the applicant’s proposed research direction

funding.value: Teaching assistantships need a 3.4 GPA and are chosen by a committee, with priority to new doctoral students.
funding.quote: The TA Committee makes the final selection after all required documentation has been reviewed

also.quote: with a priority given to new doctoral students

entry_route.value: A master's in computer science or engineering is expected, and a BS-to-PhD direct path also exists.
entry_route.quote: Students are expected to have a Master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline

also.quote: Students are expected to have a bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field

notes: Professional PhD in Computer Science (phd-computer-science-professional) is a separate program and is not saved here. Department TOEFL 79 (iBT) and IELTS 6.0 match the university record.
